name: footer-bar-mobile-action-bar
description: A bottom bar on phones and tablets holding whatever you put in it.

scripts.env:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate footer-bar-mobile-action-bar
scripts.test:fresh: npm run env:rebuild && npm run env:install-tests && npm run test:php
scripts.verify:zip: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/footer-bar-mobile-action-bar wp eval-file scripts/verify-package.php
scripts.check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check footer-bar-mobile-action-bar --exclude-directories=dist,scripts,tests,docs,node_modules,vendor,.superpowers,.github --exclude-files=phpcs.xml.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,.wp-env.json,jest.config.js,playwright.config.js,package.json,package-lock.json,composer.json,composer.lock,.distignore,.gitignore,.phpunit.result.cache
